slides.heading: Get assessed first if

caption:
Booked your first remedial massage and not sure what to expect? Here's how a session usually runs.

You'll start with a short health form and a chat. Mention pregnancy, recent surgery, medications or skin conditions. You only undress to your comfort level and stay covered with towels except for the area being worked on.

Pressure can be firm, but it shouldn't make you hold your breath. Ask for lighter or firmer any time. Feeling loose, tired or a little sore for a day or two is normal.

Massage works well alongside active rehab rather than instead of it. Our remedial massage therapists at Hybrid Physio look forward to meeting you. Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
